# Paperform

> Paperform is an online form builder and automation platform for SMBs, offering form creation, e-signatures (Papersign), payment processing, and integrations with tools like Google Sheets, Mailchimp, Slack, and Airtable.

Paperform enables businesses to create beautiful forms, surveys, quizzes, and landing pages with no-code tools. The platform includes Agency+ for agencies, extensive template libraries, and native integrations with popular business tools for workflow automation.

## Key Topics

- Paperform
- Papersign (e-signatures)
- Agency+
- Online form builder
- Form templates
- Google Sheets integration
- Mailchimp integration
- Slack automation
- Airtable integration
- SMB tools
- Workflow automation
- Payment processing
- NDA and legal contracts
- Education forms
- Accessibility compliance
